method: The assistant opened each of these final PNG files through Doni MCP read_file and inspected the displayed image; not inferred from screenshot capture or a test exit code.
scope: Implementation self-review only, not independent acceptance, screen-reader certification or release approval.
baseline_status: Two baseline images were captured before editing; not included in this final visual review.

captures.observation: Inspected populated synthetic editor, source fields, save-off status and existing two-card layout. No clipped main action or fabricated output.
Inspected full side-by-side answers with source-hidden labels, A/B/decision navigation, verdict controls and collapsed optional ratings; no literal null artifact.
Inspected locked synthetic result, separate copy/export/repeat actions, both revealed source names and Not rated values; clear distinction from verified accuracy.
Inspected full 390px result: stacked answer cards, full-width actions, wrapped caveats and visible persistence feedback; no horizontal clipping observed.
Inspected readonly selected plain-text decision note with visible manual copy instructions and Select all text control; result remains on screen.
Inspected scrolled long answer at 390px; source-hidden B header remains below A/B/decision navigation and body text stays readable.
Inspected answer-specific optional metric labels, Not sure selection, Clear optional ratings and lock action at 390px.
Inspected 320px long-answer reading with persistent B identity and wrapped full text; no visible horizontal overflow.
Inspected 320px optional rating controls in the wider three-column arrangement, clear-ratings action and lock button. Screenshot is scrolled, not the whole form.

Inspected 320px with CSS root text at 200%: navigation reflows into two rows without splitting short words; the unfocused skip link no longer overlays navigation. Reading uses more vertical space, intentionally.
Inspected confirmed next-pair screen: question retained, answer/source inputs blank, saving off and no carried synthetic notice.
Inspected red persistent Not saved notice and Retry saving above a revealed result, with matching nearby save feedback despite checked consent.
